title: Senior Customer Service Executive (US Market)
subtitle: I.
body:
### **I. GENERAL INTRODUCTION**

PATI Group is looking for a seasoned CS “Warrior” for the International E-commerce market (US/EU). In this position, you won’t just sit and reply to messages. You are the **revenue protection sentinel**, the one who directly handles payment disputes, and someone ready to roll up your sleeves to support logistics operations whenever necessary.

### **II. JOB DESCRIPTION**

You will take on a **Hybrid Role** and be trained to transition into a Management position with three core focuses:

**1. Customer Experience & Revenue Assurance (50%)**

- **Hotspot Handling:** Directly resolve difficult tickets and heated complaints (Escalated tickets) via Email, Chat, and Social Media.

- **Dispute Management (Disputes Warrior):** Directly handles Dispute/Chargeback cases on PayPal and Stripe payment gateways. **Goal:** Winning rate > 60%.

- **Customer Retention:** Use problem-solving skills and empathy to turn angry customers into loyal advocates.

**2. Logistics Support - Fulfillment Backup (30%)**

- **Ready to Engage:** During peak periods (Sales, Holidays) or when the Fulfillment team is overloaded, you will directly participate in order processing, tracking checks, and uploading waybills to the system.

- **Risk Control:** Proactively check the status of stuck shipments and notify customers *before* they complain.

- **Mindset:** “At PATI, there is no such thing as ‘not my job.’ Being in CS means knowing exactly which warehouse the goods are in.”

**3. Optimization & Training (20%)**

- **Process Building:** Draft and optimize the response library (Macros/Templates) to increase response speed.

- **Leadership:** Guide and mentor Fresher staff on how to handle basic situations.

### **III. JOB REQUIREMENTS**

- **Experience:** Minimum **2-3 years** in CS (preference for those who have worked in International E-commerce, Dropshipping, POD, or DTC).

- **Payment Literacy:** A deep understanding of the “rules of the game” and processing procedures of PayPal/Stripe is a major advantage.

- **English (Writing Skills):** Excellent (Advanced). Natural and professional writing style, equivalent to a native speaker.

- **Mindset:**

Service-oriented but tough and sharp when needed to protect company interests.

- Willingness to do manual work: Ready for data entry or scrutinizing every single waybill when required.

### **IV. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

- **Unlimited Income:** Competitive base salary based on capability (starting from **15,000,000 VND**) + Annual Performance Bonus (based on % of revenue growth you generate). You have the right to value yourself and negotiate with us.

- **Career Advancement:** A roadmap to becoming an Operations Team Leader.

- **Ownership Opportunity:** Eligibility for **Equity** (ownership stake) upon becoming a Key Member.

- **Premium Work Tools:** Provided with a MacBook, Premium AI accounts (Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus, etc.), VinFast car & Gym membership (subject to company policy).

- **Comprehensive Benefits:** Social Insurance, Bao Viet Health Insurance (Green Card), bi-annual company trips, and full holiday/birthday bonuses.

### **V. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

- **Recruitment Process: **To ensure we find the right “Builders” for our x20 goal, our process includes:

**Round 1 - Application & Technical Challenge: **After submitting your CV (with Portfolio attached), you will receive a technical challenge.

- **Round 2 - In-depth Interview: **A discussion regarding technical expertise and cultural fit with PATI’s management team.

- **Round 3 - Founder’s Table: **Direct strategic discussion with the CEO.

- **Working Conditions:**

**Time:**

Monday - Friday: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM, with a 1-hour lunch break.

- Saturday (Culture Day): 6:30 AM - 09:00 AM. We kick off Saturdays with team runs and weekly reflections - mind, body, and momentum aligned.

- **Location:** PATI Group Office – Ho Chi Minh City.

- **Note:** This is a full-time, onsite position to ensure the highest speed of coordination.
